requirements: Own the payout experience: Take full ownership of how experts get paid — from contract terms and time capture through disbursement, retries, and support resolution

Expand global coverage: Grow the payout rails, methods, and currencies available to experts, weighing cost, speed, reliability, and local regulation market by market
Understand the business: Work backwards from payout cost, failure rates, support volume, and expert retention to decide what gets built
Get in the weeds: Write specs and PRDs, but also build the dashboards, dig through failed payouts, and make small PRs to unblock yourself
Contracts, rates, and earnings: How work converts into money owed, and how experts see it
